gloss: confidential (within a company); for internal use only

definitions.gloss: confidential (within a company); for internal use only
definitions.explanation: A classification label indicating that a document or piece of information is restricted to employees of the company and must not be shared externally. Commonly stamped or printed on sensitive business documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}です。
{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漏|も}らさないで→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do not leak confidential information to outsiders.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{配|くば}られた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧{社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{使用後|しようご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦シュレッダー→シュレッダー：07492_shureddaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{処分|しょぶん}→処分：05520_shobun⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: Confidential documents distributed at the meeting are to be shredded after use.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧ (within the company) and {秘|ひ} (secret, confidential). This label is a standard part of Japanese corporate document classification. It is often stamped in red on the cover or header of documents.

DOCUMENT CLASSIFICATION LEVELS (from least to most restricted):
- ⟦{社内|しゃない}→社内：13731_shanai⟧⟦{限|かぎ}り→限り：00133_kagiri⟧: for internal distribution (less restrictive)
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}: confidential within the company
- ⟦{部外|ぶがい}→部外：27352_bugai⟧{秘|ひ}: confidential outside the department
- ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧: top secret

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: confidential materials
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: confidential information
- {社内|しゃない}{秘|ひ}⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: treated as confidential

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{機密|きみつ}→機密：13179_kimitsu⟧: classified, secret — a stronger, more formal term
- ⟦{極秘|ごくひ}→極秘：13162_gokuhi⟧: top secret — the highest level of confidentiality
- ⟦{部外|ぶがい}→部外：27352_bugai⟧{秘|ひ}: not to be disclosed outside the department
